## Details

### Gearmulator MD/MM

Plug-in and standalone emulation of Machinedrum and Monomachine (Gearmulator fork) booting your own OS file. Licence: GPL-3.0-only; distribution: download. Listed by altstrument; repo not read by us yet.

_Sources: altstrument (2026-11-01)_

### MDMM (Machinedrum and Monomachine Editors)

Desktop editors for Machinedrum and Monomachine that run the unit's own OS in an emulator (app or VST3/AU), optional hardware MIDI mode. Licence: GPL-3.0-only; macOS 12+ (installers unsigned); bring your own ROM, no firmware shipped. Listed by altstrument; repo read 2026-11-14 (0.9.1). Found a Machinedrum 1.63 stock bug: live recording records nothing after an SDS sample transfer until a restart (SB24).

_Related: builds on `gearmulator-md-mm` (README: grew out of joelanders' Machinedrum and Monomachine emulation) - see [PROJECT-FAMILIES.md](PROJECT-FAMILIES.md)_

_Sources: altstrument (2026-11-01), README, doc/release/v0.9.1.md (2026-11-14)_

### ems-monomachine-firmware

Custom Monomachine OS 1.32B (per-track lengths/speeds, trig conditions, song/pattern workflow, bug fixes), patched in the browser. Patcher only. Licence: unspecified; distribution: patch-your-own. Listed by altstrument; CHANGELOG read 2026-11-10. Upgrade hazards (26B09): old whole-bank BBOX .syx backups are no longer accepted (convert on 26A09 first), P2/P7 conditions become 25 %/75 %, the firmware is compressed so boot is slower.

_Sources: altstrument (2026-11-01), README (2026-11-11)_

### Monomodule

DAW plug-ins and a SysEx library app running the Monomachine engine in a DSP56300 emulator from your OS file. Licence: AGPL-3.0-only; distribution: download. Listed by altstrument; repo not read by us yet.

_Related: cites `elektron-firmware-tool` (README credits) - see [PROJECT-FAMILIES.md](PROJECT-FAMILIES.md)_

_Sources: altstrument (2026-11-01)_

### C7

Desktop app controlling the Machinedrum and Monomachine over SysEx/MIDI (kits, sounds, patterns, songs, samples) with a DAW bridge plug-in for automation. GPL-3.0.

_Sources: GitHub search 2026-11-02, README_

### Monomodule for Schwung

Port of Monomodule (chip-level Monomachine engine) to Ableton Move via Schwung, as one synth track plus the seven FX machines. GPL-3.0 per README (repo metadata says AGPL-3.0).

_Related: port of `monomodule` (README) - see [PROJECT-FAMILIES.md](PROJECT-FAMILIES.md)_

_Sources: GitHub search 2026-11-02, README_

### OP-XY MNMD

Machinedrum and Monomachine engines written from scratch (not an emulation of the chips) for the Teenage Engineering OP-XY on the Open-XY SDK. MIT. v1.3.2 (README 2026-11-12) gives each MD KIT key its own pan, level, filter, sample-rate reduction and FX sends with step locks (needs OP-XY SDK 1.10). v1.3.3/v1.3.4 (README 2026-11-13) adds a second kit, MD E12, plays the Machinedrum's sixteen E12 machines from samples the user captures from their own ROM (silent without them); both kits target SDK 1.15 for their Shift mixer.

_Related: uses tool `gearmulator-md-mm` (README: checked against gearmulator-md-mm) - see [PROJECT-FAMILIES.md](PROJECT-FAMILIES.md)_

_Sources: GitHub search 2026-11-02, README_

### BSP Machinedrum

Uses an Arturia BeatStep Pro as a front panel for the Gearmulator Machinedrum/Monomachine plug-ins, talking to the plug-ins through their MCP servers. MIT.

_Sources: GitHub search 2026-11-02, README_

### Monomachine Lab

AU/VST3 that runs one Monomachine DSP track's original DSP56300 code (15 synth and 7 FX machine dispatches, the per-track chain, kit SysEx import). Independent of Monomodule, which it points to for a fuller emulation.

_Related: cites `monomodule` (README: Monomodule informed it / related project) - see [PROJECT-FAMILIES.md](PROJECT-FAMILIES.md)_

_Sources: GitHub search 2026-11-02, README_

### Maschine MD-MM

Fork of gearmulator-md-mm with Native Instruments Maschine MK3 integration. GPL-3.0.

_Related: fork of `gearmulator-md-mm` (README) - see [PROJECT-FAMILIES.md](PROJECT-FAMILIES.md)_

_Sources: GitHub search 2026-11-02, README_

### TurboMIDI (C++)

Header-only C++ implementation of Elektron's TurboMIDI speed negotiation (up to 20x DIN MIDI speed). Since 2026-11-04 the repo no longer answers anonymously (git asks for credentials, so private or removed); still gone on 2026-11-11, so it is no longer polled.

_Sources: GitHub search 2026-11-02, README_

### Mono Chorus CLAP

A small stereo CLAP chorus plug-in (macOS) after the Monomachine's FX-CHORS: a floating-point reconstruction with eight automatable parameters (DEL, DEP, SPD, MIX, FB, WID, LP, INP), one C file, no firmware and no emulator.

_Sources: state/NEW.md 2026-11-10, README_
